name: Underworld Office
source: The main character is Eugene who accidentally falls into the world of ghosts and almost gets killed by monsters. A mysterious ghost saves Eugene and demands him to work at the Underworld Office in return…
translation: 主角尤金意外落入幽灵的世界，险些被怪物杀死。一位神秘的幽灵救了他，却要求他到幽灵事务所工作，以此作为回报……
